gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: This privileged geometry and speed teacher ran only on TRAIN cells and is not a submission candidate. A pixel-only student requires separate rule review.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The fixed teacher added gas on 1541 decisions, coasted on 351, added no brakes, and produced zero invalid actions over twelve TRAIN cells.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Teacher and control each finished 11/12. The teacher alone failed track 1 seed 5005 at 73% progress after three obstacle collisions, while control finished; the preregistered no teacher-only nonfinish gate fails. On ten jointly completed cells, median lap was 21.28 versus 22.40 seconds (5.0% faster), which cannot override the completion failure.
